3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.notes:
Choose one of the following options. You may change the chosen option after each Short or Long Rest.

Colossus Slayer. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 damage if the target is missing any Hit Points. This extra damage can be applied only once per turn.

Horde Breaker. Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you may make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target, within your weapon’s range, and that you haven’t attacked yet this turn.

3.name: Hunter's Lore
3.notes: While a creature is marked by your Hunter’s Mark, you learn whether that creature has Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and what they are.

7.name: Defensive Tactics
7.notes:
Choose one of the following options. You may change the chosen option after each Short or Long Rest.

Escape the Horde. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

Multiattack Defense. When a creature hits you with an attack, that creature has Disadvantage on all further attack rolls against you for the rest of the turn.

11.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
11.notes: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter’s Mark, you may also deal that spell’s bonus damage to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
15.notes: When you take damage, you may use a Reaction to gain Resistance to that instance of damage and to all further damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.
